def list_modules(self) ->List[str]:
        with self.conn:
            cur = self.conn.cursor()
            cur.execute(
                """
                        SELECT module FROM {table}
                        GROUP BY module
                        ORDER BY date(created_at) DESC
                        """.format(
                    table=self.table
                )
            )
            return [row[0] for row in cur.fetchall() if row[0]]
